author: fchollet
text:
Gemini 4 Carbon from @Google on ARC-AGI (Verified):

- ARC-AGI-3: 99.1%, $4.6K (provider adapter), 65.1%, $7.2K (standard harness)
- ARC-AGI-2: 94.2%, $0.38/task
- ARC-AGI-1: 98.5%, $0.16/task

Carbon beat its predecessor Argon by 18% points on ARC-AGI-3 in the standard harness.

slides_data.author: kanjun
slides_data.text:
I’m surprised this is something you’re excited about. This seems like an obviously bad objective function that would lead to a much worse world for the rest of us? 

As users we want apps optimized for our experience and joy, not P&L. These days, the internet feels like a casino due to optimization for P&L. I’m fairly certain this is not the kind of future you want to live in, upon reflection.
